reviews.review_description: They were recommended to me and they did not disappoint being around from the beginning of Solar panels in South Australia.

7 years ago this company installed 12 solar panels for our family - 3 people. The savings over the period have been amazing. The savings on electricity enabled a return on investment within 2 years. Looking at the past 12 months, our electricity bill has been $887. From feedback from friends who do not have solar panels, their accounts over the same period are about 4 times what we have paid.I not only can recommend solar panels, but the service, quality of the panels from this organisation and attention to detail has been fantastic. We have no issues and have not had to call them back. We are so glad we used this organisation.

The quote process from Solar Quotes was excellent, even though I ended up going with another supplier.The installing company, Natural Technology, did an excellent job and left me with all the paperwork I needed to arrange the grid connection and replacement meter.

System is just installed, not yet operative until Origin reprogram our smart meter. Can't comment on efficiency or after sales service.Chose Natural tech Systems due to strong recommendation from friends. Their quote was pretty much the same as others.Conversations with other quoters was really helpful as they gave me [pointers as to watch out for.

I did all my research on line and narrowed it down to 2 providers . I contacted both online only one replied. When I went to their office I stated I wished to reduce my costs , after seeing my last 4 power bills I was told they could get me free power over a year.I had a phone call from the installer to let me know he had to postpone the job because of rain & nominated another date which he honoured. On completion of the job everything was explained to me regarding how the unit operated.My system is  1.8KW which is generating 8KW per day , my break even is 4.5KW.

Natural Technology Systems (NTS) has been established in SA for a long time. They sell and install excellent products and know what they are talking about. We knew we had to wait, but the outcome was fantastic. The meter box was changed by ETSA the week before the solar system was installed. This meant the solar system was up and running immediately. In fact, even if the solar system was installed at an earlier date it would not have been operational anyway due to the long ETSA wait.The electrician and his team were very professional and courteous and even cleaned up after themselves. All the paperwork was presented to me in a sturdy folder and the inverter, the system and ETSA's workings explained. Even though the system cost more than others that advertise in the papers and tv, you really need to compare the same products and service. With NTS we only paid a very small deposit. We obtained 3 quotes from Solarquotes and 2 others from recommendations. The others asked for a hefty deposit and one even offered a discount if I signed on the spot. I'm not into pressure tactics. Some of the others were salespeople with 'flash' cars, computers and printers. These don't impress me. In fact they are a turn off.I decided to go and speak with the owner of NTS after I emailed him many times. I asked many questions with multiple emails and answers were detailed and informative. (Solarquotes helped me gain extra knowledge and know what to look for and ask too.) The owner of NTS took his time to discuss solar energy and look at the best options too.At the end of the day the home owner is left with the system. Spending a few extra dollars to source great products and service makes sense. As well as home visits before signing out, go and visit the business and take your time deciding. Ask friends of their experiences, too. I found out who not to go with as well.I highly recommend Natural Technology Systems.

The saleswoman was very friendly, knowledgable and supplied much information directly via emails. Had ongoing communication before I decided. Through advice decided to go for a larger system as this offer besta value for money. Inverter supplied was able to handle the 2 extra panels. Did not have to pay anything until system was installed and did not have to wait very long from date of signing contract.Previous salesman (other company) tried to get me to sign up on day of quote by supposedly offering large discount. So gald I resisted - would have ended up paying about the same price for a smaller system.The installers rang to negotiate a time, rang again the day before installation with a reminder, were punctual, friendly and cleaned up. They started paper work to get ETSA to change the net meter before the job was done so that I would not have to wait as long.
Difficult to estimate the quality of system and value for money as we have only had them installed for a few months. Have not yet received an electricity bill for a full solar quarter,
